text:
Calum Ritchie has played only eight games this season, and the latest chapter was confusing: the Islanders activated him from injured reserve and then sent him to the AHL, which Eyes On Isles and the New York Post both tried to explain. He has two points in those eight games at about 12 minutes a night.

The sample is too small to judge, and the early five-on-five numbers (44% of the expected goals with him on, which measure the quality of chances) mostly reflect a player who wasn't healthy. Last season he scored 13 goals in 65 games as a rookie, though Evolving-Hockey had him around replacement level with opponents creating more against him than most forwards. ESPN has cleared him from its injury report. For context, of the 111 forwards picked 22nd to 32nd from 2005 to 2024 with four-plus seasons, 55 reached 200 NHL games. He came to the Islanders from Colorado after being picked 27th in 2023. Our range has him around 27 points if he's back for good.
